text: Jess and Kaito got engaged on Saturday! He proposed on the beach in Whitby. Wedding probably next summer, nothing booked yet.
Chris says the new puppy arrives on 2nd November. A cocker spaniel called Biscuit. He's already bought far too many toys.
Pick up dry cleaning before Thursday. Suit needs to be ready for the 14th.

Elif rang in a bit of a state. Her cat Pistachio has been off his food for a week and hiding under the bed, which isn't like him at all. The vet's fitting him in on Monday morning for bloods and possibly an X-ray. Her partner Jonah is away with work until Wednesday, so she's on her own with it. I should text her that evening to see what they said, and offer to go with her if they need to go back the next day.
Rana and Jonah celebrate ten years married on 3rd of December. They're thinking of going back to Lisbon, where they had the honeymoon.
Luca mentioned his sister Francesca is getting married in Florence on 12 June. He's best man and terrified about the speech.
Need to renew the car insurance by 28/10. Also book the MOT for the week after.
Pedro's dog Rolo turns five on Sunday. Apparently there's a doggy cake involved. Don't forget to send him a photo of the bandana I found.

Long coffee with Mabel. The wedding's off. She and Thomas split up last month, a fortnight after the venue deposit went through, and she's moving back in with her mum in Derby at the end of November. She's putting a brave face on it and joking about selling the dress online, but she's clearly struggling and not sleeping. Her dog Wilf is staying with Thomas for now, which is upsetting her more than anything. Must check in with her next week.
Barbara is allergic to cats, so no visits to Caroline's while the kittens are there.
Eduardo and Lior's anniversary is 9 March. Eduardo wants to surprise Lior with a weekend in Edinburgh but hasn't booked anything.
Aneesh's engagement party is on 22nd November at his parents' place in Leicester. Shreya is organising the food. I'm bringing the drinks.
Kai asked whether I could look after his rabbit, Pepper, from 1st to 8th December while he's in Japan. Said yes. Remind me to get the hutch keys from him the day before he flies.
Niamh thinks Siobhan would love a pasta-making class for her birthday. She's been dropping hints for months.
Dalia's old greyhound, Juno, was put to sleep yesterday. She'd had her for twelve years. Send Dalia some flowers tomorrow.
Haircut booked for 6 Nov at 10:30. Grab the parcel from the post office afterwards.
Efua said her parents' fortieth wedding anniversary is on 18th of January. The whole family is flying to Accra for it, and she's in charge of the slideshow.
Kiara's puppy, a little beagle called Moss, had his first jabs this morning. He cried the whole time apparently.

Reggie and Sophie are getting married on 5 September next year! Venue is a barn near Hebden Bridge, and the ceremony is at two with food afterwards. Save the dates are going out in January. Sophie wants something small, maybe forty people; Reggie's mum wants a hundred guests and a ceilidh. That might get interesting. Sophie also asked if I'd do a reading, which I'm quietly thrilled about.
Adriana says Dev's proposal didn't go to plan. The ring fell through the decking at the cabin. They did get engaged in the end though!
Connor is nervous about his best man speech for his brother Kai's wedding on 15th of March. I said I'd read a draft. I should ask him for it a week before.
Carmen and Dawit are expecting their first baby in April. Carmen's had awful morning sickness, poor thing.
Oven cleaner, bin bags, birthday card for Gran. Post office closes at 1 on Saturday.

Jess's cat Mango had surgery on her back leg on Tuesday after getting hit by a car on 10 October. Home now with a cone and strict cage rest for six weeks. Jess is exhausted from getting up in the night, and the bill came to nearly two thousand pounds because the insurance had lapsed. Her boyfriend Luca has been brilliant apparently. Re-check is on 4th of November.
Rana wants to know if we can do dinner on the 30th. Check the calendar and get back to her.
Chris Morris from work is retiring on 19 December after thirty years. Leaving drinks the same evening at the Crown. Need to chip in for the collection before then.
Kaito's grandad passed away on 10/10. The funeral is in Osaka next week and he's flying out on Friday. Message him the day after he gets back.
Francesca's dog Pip has gone missing near the park. She's put posters up. Share her post on the neighbourhood group tonight.
Got to sort the boiler service. They can come 4th or 7th Nov, mornings only.
Lior is vegan and Eduardo doesn't eat mushrooms. Bear in mind for the dinner party.
Mrs Baker from next door said her husband's eightieth is on 2 November. Their daughter is coming over from Canada for it. Might pop a card through the door that morning.
Pedro and his wife Adriana renewed their vows in Portugal last week. The photos are gorgeous. I should ask how the party went afterwards.
Siobhan said the hamster escaped again. Found it in the airing cupboard.
Shreya's brother Aneesh got engaged to Kiara over the weekend. Shreya says their mum cried for an hour. Send them a congratulations card.
Thomas has a new job at the vet's in Harrogate. Started on Monday and loves it so far.
Caroline is collecting her new puppy on the 26th. She asked if I knew a good trainer. I'll send her Barbara's number.

Admin for the next fortnight. Dentist moved to Wednesday 12 Nov, 8:45, so cancel the gym session that morning. Passport renewal photos need doing before the 15th. The council tax direct debit changes on 1st of December. Car goes in for its service on the 18th, and I'm taking the train to work that day and the day after while they wait for the part.
Dawit says their tortoise, Gerald, is going into hibernation next week. Apparently he's older than Dawit.

Kai and Niamh's wedding was amazing. Niamh's dad gave the best speech I've ever heard, and Kai cried through the vows. Their spaniel was ring bearer and only ran off once. They fly to Bali on Tuesday for two weeks, back on the 9th. Remember to drop the wedding present round the weekend after they're back, and print a couple of the photos from the photo booth to go with it.
Mabel's sister Efua is having her hen do in Bath on 8th of February. Mabel is maid of honour and stressed about the budget.
Uncle Reggie's dog Bonnie had a lump removed on Friday. Results due on the 27th. Ring him the day after to see what the vet found.
Sophie says Connor's been feeling down since his engagement ended. He doesn't want to talk about it yet, so I'm giving him space.
Elif's birthday is 17th of November. She wants a new lead for the dog and keeps sending me links to a leather one.
Book the vet for Luna's booster. Due before 15 Dec. Ask about flea treatment while I'm there.
Jonah and Rana's daughter starts nursery on 3rd of November. Rana is dreading the drop-off.
Luca and Jess had their engagement shoot in the Lake District on Sunday. It poured down, but she says the photos came out brilliantly.
Dr Gupta told Barbara her knee surgery is scheduled for 21 January. She'll need lifts to physio for a few weeks afterwards. I'm driving her on the Thursdays.
Efua's kitten Toast has learnt to open the fridge.
Aneesh Chen and his wife Dalia have their anniversary dinner on the 11th. He asked me to book the table at Ottolenghi for 7pm because he's hopeless with websites. Do that today before they sell out.
Dev mentioned his nan's ninetieth is 4/12. Big family lunch the Sunday after at a pub in Kent.
Weekend plan: Saturday is the garden tip run and painting the shed. Sunday, nothing at all.

Kiara is really struggling with the wedding planning. Her mum keeps changing the guest list, Aneesh's family want a second reception in Leicester, and the venue wants a final number by 1 December. She said she'd elope if it weren't for her nan. Dress fitting is on the 22nd and she's dreading it. Call her over the weekend just to let her vent, and maybe suggest a spa day the week after the fitting.

Carmen said Dawit's parents celebrate their golden anniversary on 30 May. They're throwing a party in Addis Ababa and the whole family is invited. She's not sure they can afford the flights, especially with the baby due a month before. Dawit really wants to go. I said I'd look for cheap flights in the sales, so must remember to check on Black Friday.
Caroline and Pedro have been together five years today. He got her a puppy, of all things. A golden retriever called Honey. She was in tears.
Thomas's mum is getting remarried on 20 April, the day after his birthday. He's not thrilled about the stepdad but is going anyway.
Grab a frame for the wedding photo. Something oak, A4. The print should arrive on the 3rd.
Jess loves anything to do with birdwatching. Has been saving for a decent pair of binoculars. Christmas idea?
Francesca Bianchi, Fran to everyone, has just been made head of design. Starts the new role on 1 December. Text her congrats tonight.
Siobhan's cat Mischief had kittens on Friday night, five of them. She's keeping one and asked if I want one. Need to talk to my landlord first.

Chat with Lior and Dev at the barbecue about their trip. They leave for Iceland on 14 October next year, back the 24th. Lior wants to see the northern lights, Dev mostly wants the hot springs. Lior's sister Niamh is house-sitting and looking after their cat Ziggy. Dev's a bit anxious about flying, so I should send him that podcast on fear of flying a few days before they go.
